{{Quote|I regret my association with those rakghouls. Extreme times call for extreme measures. Field Marshal Kol promised the Ash'ad the relics. They belong to those who believe in honor. Shae Vizla does not.|Troya Ajak|<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />}}
'''Troya Ajak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ash'ad]] warrior and former [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who lived during the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|We stand with the Marshal. And you stand in our way.|Troya Ajak, to the Commander and Rass Ordo|<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />}}
In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="TOR Dates Forums" /> Troya Ajak and the Ash'ad joined in on an [[Attack on the Spirit of Vengeance II|attack]] on the Mandalorian ship the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance II]]'' alongside [[Clan Varad]] and the [[Dar'manda]] at the behest of [[Heta Kol]] in exchange for Mandalorian relics, which Ajak considered symbols of honor and a reminder of what the Mandalorians once were. There she encountered the [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Rass Ordo]], who she engaged in combat. The fight ended with her death.<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'' {{1st}}
